verdict.rationale: Buzz lets you control where data lives by self-hosting. You can run your own relay on a single node or VPS, or install the live Helm chart. Its production profile points at your own external Postgres, Redis and S3-compatible storage, and the docs say "no external services required" and "that place is yours." Residency is therefore achieved by running your own infrastructure rather than through a documented region-selection feature. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for operator-hosted or shared deployments, data-residency documentation or guarantees, and independent hands-on corroboration.
